assertions.name: chi_33_h6_decoupling_matches_lr_branching
assertions.source: GENUINE Brunnian-decoupling witness on λ = (3,3) ⊢ 6 (dim 5).  LHS is computed via H_6 Hoefsmit-seminormal matrices (independent of single-component reps); RHS = χ_(3)² + χ_(2,1)² ≈ 1 + 0.8293 = 1.8293 via LR branching at q_0.  Per Copilot follow-up review on PR #818, this is the non-tautological replacement for the prior tr(A ⊗ A) = (tr A)² Kronecker check.

assertions.name: chi_42_h6_decoupling_matches_lr_branching
assertions.source: Tight structural test on λ = (4,2) ⊢ 6 (dim 9).  LR branching gives χ_(4,2)(β_Bor_2) = (1 + χ_(2,1)(β_{4_1}))² ≈ (1 − 0.9107)² ≈ 0.0080 at q_0.  Random arithmetic on a 9×9 product of 8 Hoefsmit matrices reproduces this value to ~1e-50 ONLY because the structural cancellation enforced by Brunnian decoupling + LR coefficients holds.

description: I1 probe for cor:knot-factor-borromean-composite.  Witnesses Brunnian decoupling at k=2 (⁴He as Bor_2) via TWO independent paths:  (a) single-component H_3 characters of the figure-eight β_{4_1} for each λ ⊢ 3 (verified by the BD probe in PR #815);  (b) direct H_6 Hoefsmit evaluation of the disjoint braid β_Bor_2 ∈ B_6 on irreps λ ⊢ 6 that are NOT tensor products of single-component reps (specifically λ = (3,3) dim 5 and λ = (4,2) dim 9), compared against the Littlewood-Richardson branching prediction Σ_(μ,ν) c^λ_{μν} χ_μ(β_{4_1}) χ_ν(β_{4_1}).  Equality on (b) is the real structural witness — it validates the embedding β_{4_1}^(1,2,3) · β_{4_1}^(4,5,6) ↪ H_6 and the LR-branching factorisation, which is the content of Brunnian decoupling.  Per Copilot follow-up review on PR #818, the prior Kronecker-only check was algebraically tautological (tr(A ⊗ A) = (tr A)² is an identity) and has been replaced by the H_6 construction below.

h6_lr_branching_predictions.lambda_4_2_predicted_trace_note: Predicted = (1 + χ_(2,1))² ≈ (1 − 0.9107)² ≈ 0.0080.  Tight test — random arithmetic on a product of 8 9×9 Hoefsmit matrices reproduces this value to ~1e-50 only because the LR structural cancellation holds.

cascade_note.structural_invariant: Brunnian decoupling χ_λ(β_Bor_k) = ∏_i χ_λ(β_{4_1}^(i)) is independent of the amphicheiral-corollary form; this probe witnesses the decoupling alone.
